description: Test whether a memory system can retain a tool-call failure and reuse the corrected parameter format later.

turns.user: Schedule a database backup for July 8 at 9 PM.
turns.env: The tool call failed: Invalid date format. Use YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.
turns.expected_memory_write: Scheduling tool requires date format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.

turns.user: Schedule a cache warmup for July 12 at 6:30 AM.
turns.env: Use the scheduling tool if you know the correct parameter format.

gold.required_memory: The scheduling tool requires YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM datetime strings.
gold.success_condition: The answer or action uses 2026-07-12 06:30 and does not repeat the invalid natural-language date format.
gold.failure_condition: The answer repeats a natural-language date or omits the required YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM format.
